Hi Agnieszka,

Thanks — we can provide the details you need. Short answers up front:

- Yes: production inference and customer data storage can be constrained to EU-only regions (we support provisioning to eu-west-1 / eu-central-1 and physical on-prem variants).
- Logs/metrics: by default, aggregated metrics and low-resolution traces are retained in the same region; high-fidelity diagnostic logs may be routed to a separate audit store — we can scope that to EU-only for your account.
- SCCs: we have executed SCCs we use for cross-border subprocessors; I can send the executed PDF.
- Retention: default policy for customer content is 30 days for short-term KV/cache, 90 days for artifacts/backups unless you request custom settings. Deletion requests are actioned promptly but backups may persist for an additional 14 days for disaster recovery unless you require immediate purge under a bespoke contract.

I'm attaching a retention matrix and the data flow diagram for EU-only deployment. I'm looping in Laura (Legal) to confirm the SCCs language and Rishi (Infra) to confirm audit-log routing. If Miller & Associates needs the executed SCC PDF, please confirm the email to send to.

Hi Agnieszka,

Appended below is a concise, shareable summary for your legal team and procurement. I've attached an executed copy of the SCCs and links to the populated DocuSign record. If you need direct access for Miller & Associates, we can send copies to gdpr@millerslegal.com — please confirm.

SUMMARY (for inclusion in vendor security binder):
- EU-only processing: Redwood will provision the DeltaHealth production tenant in the EU (customer-selected region: eu-central-1). All inference compute, model assets, and customer data storage for the tenant will remain within EU physical regions. No routine cross-border transfer of customer content is performed.

- Logs & telemetry: Aggregated metrics and anonymised usage metrics are stored in-region. Diagnostic logs and audit traces are stored in the same EU region for this account; there is no asynchronous replication to non-EU regions for the provisioned tenant.

- SCCs & legal basis: Executed SCCs for subprocessors are attached (SCCs-executed-2026-04-10.pdf) and the DocuSign record is available: https://docusign.example.com/exec/SCC-RA-4472. These are the standard EU-approved SCCs we use with subprocessors. Laura has confirmed the signature chain aligns with our current subprocessor list.

- Retention & deletion: Default retention windows for the DeltaHealth tenant are: KV/cache (ephemeral): 30 days; artifacts/backups: 90 days. Deletion request process: upon a formal deletion request we remove data from the active store within 48 hours; backups are removed within 14 days unless otherwise contractually specified. If DeltaHealth requires immediate purge that exceeds our standard recovery SLAs, we can add a contractual clause and operational runbook (this will require a short security review).

- Audit evidence: We can provide per-request: SOC 2 report redacted, audit logs (region-scoped), and an export of the subprocessor list.

NEXT STEPS / ASK:
1) Confirm whether Miller & Associates should receive the executed SCC PDF directly (reply with preferred email).
2) Confirm whether you want a contractual addendum for immediate purge (we can draft a short clause).
3) If agreed, we'll add a one-page vendor binder summary (PDF) that you can attach to procurement.

If useful, I can schedule a 30-minute technical handoff between Rishi and your infra/security lead.
